name: Delirium family information visual family
principle: Create a quiet family resemblance between Delirium Support and the Delirium Family Guide. Do not create a new umbrella brand or make the free health-information site look commercial.

usage.delirium_support: Keep sans-serif headings and body type. Use deep teal and mist green more consistently, with gold only for selected rules, icons and the quiet book panel. Retain the urgent-action colour as a separate safety signal.
usage.family_guide: Use serif display headings, sans-serif body copy, deep teal fields, mist backgrounds and restrained gold actions derived from the cover.
usage.the4at: Do not recolour the clinical site. Use the family-information palette only inside the Family Guide panel and links.
usage.accessibility: Do not use warm gold for small text on white. Pair gold with deep teal, or use it as a border, icon or large decorative field. Preserve strong focus indicators and urgent-action contrast.

typography.family_guide_display: Georgia or equivalent readable book serif
typography.rule: Share proportions, spacing and colour before trying to make the typography identical.

brand_architecture.shared_descriptor: Clear information about delirium for patients, families and carers
